reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: util_rate() is called from market.move:1024 and market_query.move:68,77 (non-test callers). Gate 2: attack path enters via user-facing public lending entry points (deposit/borrow/repay/liquidate) — no trust_assumptions field in scope; entry points are untrusted. Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in scope and interest rate manipulation is a listed focus area. An attacker can trigger this via the deposit/borrow entry points by depositing a large amount, borrowing the maximum (leaving cash=1), then triggering any accrue_interest call after ~63 seconds, causing cash_reserve to exceed cash, util_rate() to return >1, and calc_interest() to compute an interest rate above max_borrow_rate — violating the rate cap guarantee for all borrowers. Severity retained at Medium: the condition requires near-total utilization to already be present, limiting realistic impact, but the invariant violation (util_rate > 1) is unambiguous and the attack is permissionless.
